verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway is explicitly documented and shipped with a plugin architecture 'for enforcing traffic controls, rate limiting...' and advanced routing, applicable per route/service/consumer via its RESTful admin API or declarative config (decK). This is a core, well-documented gateway capability with GitHub and docs corroboration. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of per-consumer rate-limit configuration specifics and any dedicated rate-limiting plugin doc page in this pack.
